label: ACCEPT
reason: Every icon (REST-api.ts, database.ts, google.ts, claude.ts) passes an svgDefaults object with fill; the only listed exception is the defaultAttributes object the factory spreads, a one_off, so the simplest violation decides. svgDefaults is optional in createSupabaseIcon.ts, so tsc misses it, and validateIcons.mjs only checks fill on stroke icons, so a fill-only icon without fill would silently fall back to defaultAttributes' fill 'none'. The team deliberately requires an explicit root fill, so flagging that is worth it. clear:false because callers import createSupabaseIcon, not the internal name createLucideIcon. I hesitated with WRONG incidental, since the generator (exportTemplate.mjs) copies fill from the raw SVG.

label: ACCEPT
reason: genGuideMeta (GuidesMdx.utils.tsx:173) is generic: it takes any function that returns {meta, pathname}, and non-markdown pages such as self-hosting/auth/config/page.tsx already use it with a constant meta. So the ai-prompts page could wrap its title the same way. Instead it uses generateAiPromptMetadata (AiPrompts.utils.ts), which returns only a title, with no description, canonical or OpenGraph. That is a real omission (1 of 1 counted). Next.js and eslint.config.cjs do not require the wrapper.
